# Metrics

!!! note "Generated page"
    `scripts/docs/gen_metrics.py` builds this page from the code. Text that needs a person lives in `scripts/docs/descriptions.yml`. Edit that file, not this page.

All metrics go through the helpers in `common/lib/metrics.py`. They publish only when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` is set, and always through the OTLP gRPC exporter. `OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL` sets the export interval. Metrics from OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation are not listed.

The code emits 58 metric names.

| Metric | Type | Emitted in | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conserver.api.count_vcons_enqueued` | counter | `api/api.py` | vCons the API added to an ingress list. Attributes are `ingress_list` and `source`, which is `new`, `external`, `reingress` or `dlq_reprocess`. |
| `conserver.dlq.count` | counter | `common/lib/queue.py` | vCons moved to a dead letter queue, ingress or storage. Attribute is `queue_name`. |
| `conserver.ingress_list.length` | observable gauge | `common/lib/queue_metrics.py` | Current `LLEN` of each configured ingress list and its dead letter queue. Attributes are `ingress_list` and `kind`, which is `ingress` or `dlq`. |
| `conserver.lib.vcon_redis.get_vcon_not_found` | counter | `common/lib/vcon_redis.py` | A `VconRedis.get_vcon` call found the vCon in neither Redis nor storage. |
| `conserver.lib.vcon_redis.get_vcon_redis_miss` | counter | `common/lib/vcon_redis.py` | A `VconRedis.get_vcon` call missed Redis. |
| `conserver.lib.vcon_redis.get_vcon_storage_hit` | counter | `common/lib/vcon_redis.py` | A `VconRedis.get_vcon` call missed Redis and found the vCon in storage. |
| `conserver.link.count` | counter | `conserver/main.py` | Link runs. Attributes are `link_name` and `outcome`, which is `success`, `halt` or `error`. |
| `conserver.link.datatrails.event_creation_failures` | counter | `conserver/links/datatrails/__init__.py` | Failed DataTrails event creation. |
